description: Angular component for an asset profile dialog, allowing users to add or edit asset profiles within the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: AssetProfileDialogData
classes.description: Interface defining data passed to the asset profile dialog, including the asset profile object and a flag indicating if it's an addition.

classes.name: AssetProfileDialogComponent
classes.description: Angular component for the asset profile dialog, supporting add/edit operations with form validation and service integration.

methods.name: ngAfterViewInit
methods.description: Lifecycle hook that marks the form as dirty if adding a new asset profile.

methods.name: isErrorState
methods.description: Determines if a form control is in an error state, considering custom submission status.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates and saves the asset profile via the service, then closes the dialog with the result.
